high_level_description: The image is entirely black with white text centered at the bottom. The text reads: "One of them is a cop," in a simple, sans-serif font. There are no people, objects, or any discernible setting depicted in the image. The mood conveyed by the image is mysterious and somewhat ominous due to the stark contrast between the black background and the white text, as well as the cryptic nature of the statement. The absence of any other visual elements leaves the viewer to interpret the meaning of the text on their own, adding an element of intrigue or suspense.
